title: Complex Schr\"odinger Bridges
abstract: arXiv:2611.17746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schr\"odinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. translated_abstract: 扩散桥已成为促进任意数据分布之间相互转换的通用框架。然而，这些方法受到庞大优化空间及其底层高阶结构的阻碍。本文探索了扩散桥的一种变体，用于解决复向量空间中由缩放和旋转定律（如哈密顿结构）所支配的现实问题。为此，我们引入了共形最优传输（COT），这是一种复值传输框架，专为在几何提升下具有几何性与耗散动力学的物理系统而设计。在此基础上，我们提出了一类新的动态扩散桥，称为复值薛定谔桥（CSBs），其衍生算法能够利用共形几何先验来处理基于扩散的任务。为了提升可扩展性，我们提出了图像到图像的CSB（I²CSB），这是一种易于处理的扩散桥技术，具有解析形式的……
tldr: 该论文提出了共形最优传输（COT）框架与复值薛定谔桥（CSBs）这一新型动态扩散桥方法，通过共形几何先验有效处理复向量空间中受缩放和旋转定律支配的物理系统的扩散任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces conformal optimal transport (COT) and complex Schrödinger bridges (CSBs), a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges that leverage a conformal geometric prior to tackle diffusion-based tasks in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws.
